manaNeeded: {3}{B}{R}{G} plus enough mana to pay for commander tax, if applicable
description:
Cast Prossh from the command zone by paying {3}{R}{G} and commander tax, if applicable.
Prossh triggers, creating a 0/1 Kobolds of Kher Keep token for each mana spent to cast it.
The Kobolds enter the battlefield, triggering Purphoros that many times, dealing 2 damage to each opponent for each Kobold.
Prossh enters the battlefield, triggering Purphoros, dealing 2 damage to each opponent.
Activate Phyrexian Altar three times by sacrificing Prossh and two Kobolds, adding {B}{R}{G}.
Choose to return Prossh from your graveyard to the command zone.
Activate Phyrexian Altar by sacrificing all remaining Kobolds, adding {1} for each Kobold sacrificed this way.
 Repeat for each {1} additional mana you have available.
